about.en: Circle Internet Group (Ondo Tokenized) (CRCLon) is an Ondo tokenized stock issued by Ondo Global Markets (BVI) Limited through the Ondo Stocks platform, giving eligible non-US holders economic exposure to Circle Internet Group, Inc. Class A shares (CRCL). It is fully backed by the underlying security and is a total return tracker: dividends are reinvested net of withholding tax, so one token can come to represent more than one share and its price can drift above the underlying's. It is an ERC-20 on Ethereum at 0x3632dea96a953c11dac2f00b4a05a32cd1063fae, with deployments on BNB Chain and Solana. Holders have a claim on the issuer, not registered ownership or shareholder rights.
